sql: SELECT r.region, count() AS jumlah_deal_baru FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY jumlah_deal_baru DESC

question: rata2 durasi call per sentimen utk customer SMB
sql: SELECT a.sentiment, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.type = 'call' AND c.segment = 'SMB' GROUP BY a.sentiment

question: Hitung jumlah pelanggan unik dengan deal won tahun ini per tim sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Urutkan sales wilayah EMEA berdasarkan forecast terbesar.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND r.region = 'EMEA' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY forecast DESC

question: Untuk tiket resolved, tampilkan jumlah dan rata-rata waktu penyelesaiannya per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_jam_penyelesaian FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status = 'resolved' GROUP BY c.segment

question: rekap jumlah aktivitas per bulan tim Account-Management tahun ini
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.team = 'Account-Management' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Berapa pelanggan churn di tiap wilayah yang pernah mengajukan tiket urgent?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'churned' AND t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY wilayah ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Nilai deal terbesar untuk tiap segmen pelanggan berapa?
sql: SELECT c.segment, max(d.value) AS nilai_terbesar FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Hitung rasio tiket urgent per industri pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, round(countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count(), 2) AS rasio_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY industri ORDER BY rasio_urgent DESC

question: jumlah tiket terbuka per tag customer
sql: SELECT tag, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY tag ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Sales mana yang punya lebih dari 20 deal lost tahun ini?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_lost > 20 ORDER BY jumlah_lost DESC

question: Rata-rata nilai deal yang dibuat tahun ini per tier pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY tier ORDER BY rata_nilai DESC

question: Tampilkan jumlah aktivitas tiap sales hari ini.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE toDate(a.timestamp) = today() GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Berapa pelanggan per status yang pernah mendapat demo?
sql: SELECT c.status, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.type = 'demo' GROUP BY c.status ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Rata-rata jumlah produk per deal untuk masing-masing segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(length(d.products_involved)), 2) AS rata_jumlah_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: omset per wilayah customer 90 hari terakhir, urutkan dr yg terbesar
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY wilayah ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Rekap jumlah aktivitas positif, netral, dan negatif per tim sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') AS jumlah_positif, countIf(a.sentiment = 'neutral') AS jumlah_netral, countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') AS jumlah_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket prioritas high berdasarkan status pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.status, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_jam_penyelesaian FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'high' GROUP BY c.status ORDER BY rata_jam_penyelesaian DESC

question: Ada berapa sales di tiap tim yang berhasil closing deal won bulan ini?
sql: SELECT r.team, uniqExact(r.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.team

question: list pelanggan yg udah dihubungi lebih dari 20 kali
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment HAVING jumlah_aktivitas > 20

question: Total nilai deal yang melibatkan Analytics-Suite per tim sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE has(d.products_involved, 'Analytics-Suite') GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY total_nilai DESC

question: Berapa total omset dari pelanggan yang dibuat tahun ini, dipecah per segmen?
sql: SELECT c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN deals AS d FINAL ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Tampilkan total durasi aktivitas support_ticket per wilayah sales bulan lalu.
sql: SELECT r.region, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'support_ticket' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY total_durasi DESC

question: Bandingkan omset bulan ini dan bulan lalu untuk setiap tim sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_ini, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())) AS omset_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY omset_bulan_ini DESC

question: Rekap per sales untuk deal yang ditutup tahun ini: jumlah deal won, total omset, dan win rate.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Sales mana yang win rate-nya di atas 0.65 dengan minimal 50 deal yang sudah closed (won/lost)?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) AS jumlah_closed, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_closed >= 50 AND win_rate > 0.65 ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: Tampilkan semua sales dan jumlah aktivitasnya dalam 7 hari terakhir, termasuk sales yang tidak ada aktivitas.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region, countIf(a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 7)) AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM sales_reps AS r LEFT JOIN activities AS a ON r.rep_id = a.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region

question: Cari pelanggan aktif yang sama sekali tidak punya deal berjalan.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL LEFT JOIN deals AS d FINAL ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) = 0

question: Per produk, berapa omset tahun ini dan berapa perusahaan unik yang membelinya?
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, uniqExact(c.company) AS jumlah_perusahaan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY product ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: bandingin rata2 waktu penyelesaian tiket urgent vs low per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'urgent'), 2) AS rata_jam_urgent, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'low'), 2) AS rata_jam_low FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Untuk wilayah pelanggan dengan lebih dari 100 tiket, hitung total tiket dan rasio tiket terbukanya.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, count() AS total_tiket, round(countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY wilayah HAVING total_tiket > 100 ORDER BY rasio_terbuka DESC

question: Berapa rata-rata hari dari deal dibuat sampai won per tim sales, untuk deal yang won tahun ini?
sql: SELECT r.team, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_hari_closing FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY rata_hari_closing

question: List pelanggan Enterprise dengan minimal 10 aktivitas yang rasio sentimen negatifnya di atas 0.4.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count(), 2) AS rasio_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment HAVING jumlah_aktivitas >= 10 AND rasio_negatif > 0.4

question: Rekap total menit demo dan meeting per tim sales selama 30 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(a.duration_minutes, a.type = 'demo') AS total_menit_demo, sumIf(a.duration_minutes, a.type = 'meeting') AS total_menit_meeting FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY r.team

question: rekap bulanan tahun ini: jumlah deal won dan omset dari customer ber-tag tech
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(c.tags, 'tech') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Bandingkan total nilai pipeline dengan weighted pipeline di setiap wilayah sales.
sql: SELECT r.region, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY weighted_pipeline DESC

question: Tampilkan pelanggan churn beserta tanggal tiket terakhir dan jumlah tiketnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, max(t.created_at) AS tiket_terakhir, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment

question: Pelanggan aktif mana saja yang aktivitas terakhirnya sudah lebih dari 60 hari yang lalu?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, max(a.timestamp) AS aktivitas_terakhir FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING aktivitas_terakhir < subtractDays(now(), 60) ORDER BY aktivitas_terakhir

question: Untuk tiket tahun ini, rekap per segmen: jumlah tiket, jumlah yang sudah resolved/closed, dan rata-rata jam penyelesaian tiket high atau urgent.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_tiket, countIf(t.status IN ('resolved','closed')) AS jumlah_selesai, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority IN ('high','urgent')), 2) AS rata_jam_prioritas_tinggi FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.segment

question: Berapa rasio deal won yang melibatkan Cloud-Storage-Pro di tiap tim sales?
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(has(d.products_involved, 'Cloud-Storage-Pro')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_cloud_storage FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY rasio_cloud_storage DESC

question: Top 10 pelanggan berdasarkan omset tahun ini, sertakan jumlah deal won dan rata-rata nilainya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 10

question: Hitung win rate dan omset per tier pelanggan untuk deal yang ditutup tahun ini.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY tier ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: sales yg pipeline-nya lebih dari 20 deal tapi win rate di bawah 0.65 siapa aja?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS jumlah_pipeline, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_pipeline > 20 AND win_rate < 0.65 ORDER BY win_rate

question: Per wilayah pelanggan, hitung total tiket terbuka dan berapa pelanggan unik yang punya tiket terbuka urgent.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, count() AS jumlah_tiket_terbuka, uniqExactIf(c.customer_id, t.priority = 'urgent') AS pelanggan_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY wilayah ORDER BY jumlah_tiket_terbuka DESC

question: Rekap bulanan tahun ini untuk tim Outbound-Enterprise: jumlah aktivitas dan rasio sentimen positif.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') / count(), 2) AS rasio_positif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Per tag pelanggan, berapa jumlah deal won dan total omset tahun ini?
sql: SELECT tag, count() AS jumlah_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY tag ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Tampilkan semua pelanggan tier Gold dan total omsetnya, termasuk yang belum pernah punya deal won.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL LEFT JOIN deals AS d FINAL ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment

question: Untuk sales wilayah APAC, bandingkan rata-rata durasi aktivitas yang sentimennya positif vs negatif.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.sentiment = 'positive'), 2) AS rata_durasi_positif, round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.sentiment = 'negative'), 2) AS rata_durasi_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.region = 'APAC' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: Perusahaan mana saja yang tahun ini punya deal won sekaligus deal lost?
sql: SELECT c.company, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.company HAVING jumlah_won > 0 AND jumlah_lost > 0 ORDER BY jumlah_won DESC

question: Untuk deal berjalan yang dibuat 90 hari terakhir, hitung per segmen jumlah pelanggan unik dan weighted pipeline-nya.
sql: SELECT c.segment, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.created_date >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY weighted_pipeline DESC

question: aktivitas 30 hari terakhir per tipe buat customer APAC yg tag-nya strategic atau high-value: jumlah aktivitas & jumlah customer unik
sql: SELECT a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE hasAny(c.tags, ['strategic','high-value']) AND c.attributes['region'] = 'APAC' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Per tim sales, hitung jumlah deal pipeline bernilai di atas 250.000 dan rasionya terhadap seluruh pipeline tim.
sql: SELECT r.team, countIf(d.value > 250000) AS jumlah_deal_besar, round(countIf(d.value > 250000) / count(), 2) AS rasio_deal_besar FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY rasio_deal_besar DESC

question: Tiket terbuka pelanggan aktif yang umurnya lebih dari 30 hari: berapa jumlahnya dan rata-rata umurnya (hari) per prioritas?
sql: SELECT t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(dateDiff('day', t.created_at, now())), 2) AS rata_umur_hari FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND c.status = 'active' AND t.created_at < subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY rata_umur_hari DESC

question: Rekap deal pipeline per wilayah sales dan stage: jumlah deal serta rata-rata umur deal dalam hari.
sql: SELECT r.region, d.stage, count() AS jumlah_deal, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, now())), 2) AS rata_umur_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.region, d.stage ORDER BY r.region, d.stage

question: Untuk industri yang tiket urgent-nya lebih dari 50, tampilkan total tiket, jumlah tiket urgent, dan rata-rata jam penyelesaian tiket urgent.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, count() AS total_tiket, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS jumlah_urgent, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.priority = 'urgent'), 2) AS rata_jam_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY industri HAVING jumlah_urgent > 50 ORDER BY jumlah_urgent DESC

question: Untuk sales tim Inbound tahun ini, berapa pelanggan unik yang dihubungi dan rata-rata jumlah aktivitas per pelanggan?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, round(count() / uniqExact(a.customer_id), 2) AS rata_aktivitas_per_pelanggan FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.team = 'Inbound' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Di tiap wilayah pelanggan, deal won terbesar tahun ini nilainya berapa dan dari perusahaan mana?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, max(d.value) AS nilai_terbesar, argMax(c.company, d.value) AS perusahaan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY wilayah ORDER BY nilai_terbesar DESC

question: Tampilkan tiap sales dengan waktu aktivitas terakhirnya dan sudah berapa hari sejak itu.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region, max(a.timestamp) AS aktivitas_terakhir, dateDiff('day', max(a.timestamp), now()) AS hari_sejak_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region

question: rekap tiket terbuka per segmen & status customer: jumlah customer unik, total tiket, dan berapa yg urgent
sql: SELECT c.segment, c.status, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY c.segment, c.status ORDER BY c.segment, jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Pelanggan berstatus lead atau prospect yang punya deal negotiation dengan probabilitas minimal 60: tampilkan forecast per pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status IN ('lead','prospect') AND d.stage = 'negotiation' AND d.probability >= 60 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY forecast DESC

question: Per wilayah sales, dari deal yang dibuat tahun ini berapa jumlahnya, berapa yang won, dan rasio won-nya?
sql: SELECT r.region, count() AS jumlah_deal, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / count(), 2) AS rasio_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY rasio_won DESC

question: Tampilkan semua sales tim Account-Management beserta omset bulan ini, termasuk yang omsetnya nol.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AS total_omset FROM sales_reps AS r LEFT JOIN deals AS d FINAL ON r.rep_id = d.rep_id WHERE r.team = 'Account-Management' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region

question: Cari pelanggan yang punya minimal 3 tiket tapi belum ada satu pun yang resolved atau closed.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment HAVING jumlah_tiket >= 3 AND countIf(t.status IN ('resolved','closed')) = 0

question: Hitung win rate per produk untuk deal yang dipegang sales wilayah EMEA.
sql: SELECT product, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE r.region = 'EMEA' GROUP BY product ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: Distribusi jumlah meeting dengan pelanggan Enterprise per hari dalam seminggu (1 = Senin).
sql: SELECT toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) AS hari, count() AS jumlah_meeting FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY hari ORDER BY hari

question: Per status pelanggan, berapa rasio tiket yang selesai dalam 24 jam dari seluruh tiket yang sudah punya waktu penyelesaian?
sql: SELECT c.status, round(countIf(t.resolution_time_hours <= 24) / countIf(t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL), 2) AS rasio_selesai_24_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.status ORDER BY rasio_selesai_24_jam DESC

question: rekap call customer SMB per customer: jumlah call, total & rata2 durasi, cuma yg total durasinya > 300 menit
sql: SELECT c.name, count() AS jumlah_call, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.type = 'call' AND c.segment = 'SMB' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING total_durasi > 300 ORDER BY total_durasi DESC

question: Produk apa saja yang omset tahun lalu dari sales wilayah NA tembus 7.000.000?
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) AND r.region = 'NA' GROUP BY product HAVING total_omset > 7000000 ORDER BY total_omset DESC
